topic.title: Topic / Concept
topic.description: The story concept, product, or scenario to storyboard.

language.title: Language
language.description: Output language. Use 'en' for English or 'th' for Thai.

style.title: Production Style
style.description: The visual production style that determines visual language and pacing.

total_scenes.title: Total Scenes (optional)
total_scenes.description: Target number of scenes. If not set, determined by length.

include_camera_direction.title: Include Camera Direction
include_camera_direction.description: Whether to include camera angles and movements for each scene.

include_sound_design.title: Include Sound Design
include_sound_design.description: Whether to include sound effects and music cues for each scene.

word_count.title: Maximum words (optional)
word_count.description: If provided, the storyboard must not exceed this word count. Overrides length preset.

maxPromptLength.title: Maximum prompt length (chars)
maxPromptLength.description: Hard character limit for the full storyboard output. Use the selected media model limit as a guide.

reference_images.title: Reference Images
reference_images.description: Optional array of reference image URLs. When provided, visual elements from these images will be incorporated into the storyboard scenes.
